acceptanceCovered: DELETE /api/articles/:slug/comments/:id requires a valid token; the comment owner gets an empty HTTP 204 and only the selected comment is removed.

Non-integer IDs return 422; unknown articles return 404 with errors.article; missing or wrong-article comments return 404 with errors.comment; non-owners return 403 with errors.comment and no mutation.
The delete resolves and locks the article before the scoped comment, checks author ownership, deletes in the same transaction, and maps persistence failures to the generic 500 response.

Generated Swagger and static OpenAPI document 204, 401, 403, 404, 422 and 500; Hurl and E2E exercise their supported contracts, including non-owner authorization, while E2E injects persistence failure. Existing POST and GET comment behavior remains intact.
regressionChecked: Missing and invalid authentication return 401; non-owners receive 403 without deleting the comment.
Unknown articles and missing or wrong-article comments return their distinct 404 envelopes.
Invalid IDs return 422; injected persistence failures return a generic 500 without mutation.
Deletion is scoped by article ID, comment ID, and author ID inside one transaction; the response is an empty 204.
Article and scoped comment locks follow the required order; existing POST and GET behavior remains intact.
